headline: US, Iranian forces fire at vessels in waters near Iran
summary: US and Iranian forces fired on vessels in waters around Iran, including three Iranian oil carriers struck by the US and three tankers Iran said it targeted in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so attacks on tankers there affect crude supply and freight costs.

source.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

sources.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

why_moved: Military action against oil carriers and tankers in the Strait of Hormuz raises the risk of disruption to Gulf oil exports.
